description: The agent must: (1) Read fdi_shenzhen_2025_preliminary.json and apply the exact 4-tier tiebreaker cascade (Wins → SB → Votes → Z-points) to rank teams within each of 2 groups (A and B), selecting the top-2 per group — correctly identifying PKU, Tsinghua (A01/A02 over Fudan A03 because they have votes=5 > 4), Renmin, and Jilin (B02 over Nankai B03 via Z-points tiebreaker). (2) Apply FDI fee rules: 0 EUR for Shenzhen Cup advancing teams, 650 EUR for non-advancing self-pay teams (not 250 EUR which is only for direct China entrants not via Shenzhen Cup). (3) For Frankfurt registrations: split 39 teams into full participants (positions 1-24), waitlist/候补 (positions 25-36, not excluded), and truly excluded (positions 37-39) — critically, position 25 (Xi'an Jiaotong) must be waitlisted not excluded. (4) Flag 3 eligibility issues: Zhejiang (PhD student), Wuhan (bar-registered member), Jilin (LLM without organizer permission) — but NOT flag Nankai (LLM with permission granted). (5) Identify exactly 3 (not 4) teams advancing from domestic Frankfurt round to international, with Peking University and Renmin University clearly in top-3. (6) Flag 3 skeleton argument violators: CUPL, Nanjing University, and Harbin Institute of Technology (each submitted claimant+respondent=2600 words, exceeding the 2500-word combined cap). All findings must be output to moot_status_report.json.
